Hester would sit alone, reading; or armed with a masculine-looking walking-stick, and the brim of her felt hat turned down to shade her thin sombre face, would stalk off in the direction of the hills that formed a humped barrier upon the sky-line. At the end of a fortnight’s stay, Mrs. Blackwood who, true to the traditions of Eastwold, had discovered the leading features of interest in the lives of everyone else in the hotel, was still no wiser about Hester.

arxiv-2101-08980.title: Nonstationary Stochastic Multiarmed Bandits: UCB Policies and Minimax Regret Thanks: This work was supported by NSF Award IIS-1734272
arxiv-2101-08980.creator: Lai Wei Vaibhav Srivastava
arxiv-2101-08980.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lai Wei Vaibhav Srivastava. We study the nonstationary stochastic Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) problem in which the distribution of rewards associated with each arm are assumed to be time-varying and the total variation in the expected rewards is subject to a variation budget. The regret of a policy is defined by the difference in the expected cumulative rewards obtained using the policy and using an oracle that selects the arm with the maximum mean reward at each time.

arxiv-2103-11412.description: Abstract The Higgs sector of the standard model can be extended by introducing an S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) L SU(2)_{L} Higgs triplet Δ \Delta to generate the tiny neutrino masses in the framework of type-II seesaw mechanism.

arxiv-2112-01327.title: A modified limited memory Nesterov’s accelerated quasi-Newton
arxiv-2112-01327.creator: S. Indrapriyadarsini 2 , Shahrzad Mahboubi 3 , Hiroshi Ninomiya 3 , Takeshi Kamio 4 and Hideki Asai 2
arxiv-2112-01327.description: Abstract I Introduction The Nesterov’s accelerated quasi-Newton (L)NAQ [ 1 ] method has shown to accelerate the conventional (L)BFGS quasi-Newton method using the Nesterov’s accelerated gradient in several neural network (NN) applications. However, the calculation of two gradients per iteration increases the computational cost. An approximation to the Nesterov’s accelerated gradient was proposed in [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2212-09665.description: Abstract . A group G G is said to have restricted centralizers if for each g ∈ G g\in G the centralizer C G ​ ( g ) C_{G}(g) either is finite or has finite index in G G . Shalev showed that a profinite group with restricted centralizers is virtually abelian.

arxiv-2307-15245.title: A Practical Recipe for Federated Learning Under Statistical Heterogeneity Experimental Design
arxiv-2307-15245.creator: Mahdi Morafah, Weijia Wang, Bill Lin
arxiv-2307-15245.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) has been an area of active research in recent years. There have been numerous studies in FL to make it more successful in the presence of data heterogeneity. However, despite the existence of many publications, the state of progress in the field is unknown.

arxiv-2308-15071.title: Department of Physics, Tokyo Metropolitan University,

arxiv-2308-15071.description: Abstract Octant Degeneracy and Plots of Parameter Degeneracy in Neutrino Oscillations Revisited Sho Sugama and Osamu Yasuda Abstract The three kinds of parameter degeneracy in neutrino oscillation, the intrinsic, sign and octant degeneracy, form an eight-fold degeneracy. The nature of this eight-fold degeneracy can be visualized on the ( \sin^{2}2\theta_{13} , 1/\sin^{2}\theta_{23} )-plane, through quadratic curves defined by P(\nu_{\mu}\to\nu_{e})= const.

arxiv-2409-00563.title: Sparse Mamba: Introducing Controllability, Observability, And Stability To Structural State Space Models
arxiv-2409-00563.creator: Emadeldeen Hamdan, Hongyi Pan, Ahmet Enis Cetin
arxiv-2409-00563.description: Abstract Structured state space models’ (SSMs) development in recent studies, such as Mamba and Mamba2, outperformed and solved the computational inefficiency of transformers and large language models at small to medium scale. In this work, we introduce the concept of controllability and observability to the original Mamba SSM’s architecture in our Sparse-Mamba (S-Mamba) for natural language processing (NLP) applications.

arxiv-2510-07374.description: Abstract Observations of the redshifted 21-cm line during the Epoch of Reionization will open a new window to probe the intergalactic medium during the formation of the first stars, galaxies, and black holes. arxiv-2601-21731.title: Amortized Spectral Kernel Discovery via Prior-Data Fitted Network
arxiv-2601-21731.creator: Kaustubh Sharma, Srijan Tiwari, Ojasva Nema, Parikshit Pareek
arxiv-2601-21731.description: Abstract Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) enable efficient amortized inference but lack transparent access to their learned priors and kernels. This opacity hinders their use in downstream tasks, such as surrogate-based optimization, that require explicit covariance models. We introduce an interpretability-driven framework for amortized spectral discovery from pre-trained PFNs with decoupled attention.

pmc-11470696.description: BackgroundTomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) production is severely threatened by bacterial wilt, caused by the phytopathogenic bacterium Ralstonia solanacearum. Recently, nano-enabled strategies have shown tremendous potential in crop disease management.ObjectivesThis study investigates the efficacy of biogenic nanoformulations (BNFs), comprising biogenic silica nanoparticles (SiNPs) and melatonin (MT), in controlling bacterial wilt in tomato.MethodsSiNPs were synthesized using Zizania latifolia leaves extract.

pmc-11519258.title: Solute carrier family 4 member 4 (SLC4A4) is associated with cell proliferation, migration and immune cell infiltration in colon cancer

pmc-11519258.description: BackgroundSolute Carrier Family 4 Member 4 (SLC4A4) is a membrane protein‐coding gene for a Na+/HCO3− cotransporter and plays a crucial role in regulating pH, bicarbonate secretion and homeostasis. However, the prognostic and immunological role of SLC4A4 in colon cancer remains unknown.

pmc-12787014.title: New Alternative Surgical Technique for Managing Proximal Tibia Chronic Osteomyelitis: Anterior Approach with Establishment of Bone Marrow Communication via Intramedullary Reaming
pmc-12787014.creator: Young-Chang Park, Seung Hyun Kim
pmc-12787014.description: Background/Objectives: Surgical treatment of chronic osteomyelitis of the proximal tibia is challenging due to limited soft tissue coverage, poor blood supply, and the weight-bearing function of the bone. Moreover, structural instability following curettage may necessitate fixation with metallic implants, which carries a risk of biofilm formation and often requires multi-stage surgeries.

pmc-13156806.title: Psychosocial Factors Mediate the Relationship Between Olfactory Function and Cognitive Frailty in Older Adults: A Structural Equation Modelling
pmc-13156806.creator: Li‐Jun Chen, Chung‐Ying Lin, Chieh‐Ying Chou, Yu‐Chi Liao, Yi‐Ying Tsai, Esther En‐Shu Kuo, Fang‐Wen Hu
pmc-13156806.description: ObjectiveWith the trend of population ageing, cognitive frailty in older adults is an increasingly pressing public health issue. pmc-13201779.title: A preprocessing-enhanced stacking classifier for generalized cardiovascular disease detection across diverse datasets
pmc-13201779.creator: Adeel Ashraf, Adven Masih, Aysha Saddiqa, Jabar Mahmood, Aitzaz Ali, Mohamed Shabbir Hamza Abdulnabi, Daniel Musafiri Balungu, Xu Ying
pmc-13201779.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) remain a major global health challenge, requiring early-detection models that are both accurate and generalizable across diverse data settings. This study introduces a preprocessing-enhanced stacking ensemble for binary CVD prediction, explicitly designed to improve robustness under heterogeneous feature distributions.
